meta.title: Measured migration response to artificial light at night
meta.response_measure: Geometric mean vertically integrated reflectivity at peak exodus (cm2/ha), used as a proxy for stopover density
meta.alan_measure: 2014 artificial:natural zenith sky luminance ratio, averaged within 2 km
meta.bright_source_definition: ALAN ratio at least 5 in a 1 km source cell

published_model_results.local_brightness_response: Modelled stopover density decreased by up to 50% as local 2 km artificial-light intensity increased.
published_model_results.regional_proximity_response: Modelled stopover density decreased by up to 70% with distance from bright sources, especially beyond 50–100 km.
published_model_results.interpretation: The two predictors describe a scale-dependent association: regional concentration nearer bright areas alongside reduced use of the most locally illuminated habitat. They are not individual trajectories or a randomized causal test.

meta.coordinate_precision_note: The study used 1 x 1 km cells, but the supplied CSV text rounds UTM Y to 10 km increments and collapses many source cells onto one displayed coordinate. The globe therefore maps medians at approximate display coordinates, not reconstructed 1 km cell centers.
